summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py as the last Graph method before ConjunctiveGraph, with a nested add_to_cbd helper implementing the W3C CBD rules (subject triples with blank-node cycle guard, then rdf:subject reification with no type or predicate/object matching). Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering the rule 1/2 counts (8, 3, 2, 0), typed and untyped reifiers (8 and 13), incoming reification, non-expansion of reifier blank nodes, blank-node cycles, and source immutability. The change is additive (42 insertions in graph.py). Nothing was run: tests, flake8, and imports were checked by reading only. No commits were made.
